notes.title: 1.4.0 (Early beta) Big stability update
notes.content:
[b]Stability[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved ingame stability with a large number of player actions, especially with food
[*] Significantly reduced the number of crashes
[*] Client-server stability
[*] Reworked input system
[*] [b]TIP:[/b] If you have problems with saves, please remove all files from this directory: [i]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\HeavenSnakes\Saved\SaveGames\[/i]
[*] [b]TIP:[/b] If you have problems with input, please remove [b]Input.ini[/b] from this directory: [i]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\HeavenSnakes\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\[/i]
[/list] 

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance of game mechanics
[*] Food drawing time has been significantly reduced. That will make the world a bigger place in the future
[*] Reduced food generation time
[*] Other client-server optimizations
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased max players and bots support
[*] Released player reconnection
[*] Other gameplay, menu, settings, UI improvements
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed wrong snake length calculation
[*] Fixed zooming when snake is too big
[*] Other bug-fixes
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.2 (Early beta) Skins display fix

notes.title: 1.3.0 (Early beta) 2023 update
notes.content:
[b]Mini map[/b]
[list]
[*] Added minimap
[*] It is easier for you to navigate in space
[*] You can customize color of minimap in the game settings and save or reset it
[*] You can turn off/on minimap in the game settings. It is enabled by default [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42397317/1c4b1efe97b9649018c120cc6b13e48f35f37fb3.png[/img]
[*] In the future updates, the minimap will be updated and become more player-friendly
[/list]

[b]Performance update[/b]
[list]
[*] Many optimizations have been made, in particular, the duration of server creation has been reduced
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Updated player agreement
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.0 (Early beta) Update
notes.content:
[b]Skin store[/b]
[list]
[*] Added skin store. You can open it in the main menu. 2 common skins are available to you by default
[*] There are two types of skin: [b]Body[/b] (head and tail) and [b]Ability[/b]
[*] You can fit on any skin you want by clicking on them
[*] You can buy any skin you want by clicking the "Buy" button
[*] You can equip owning skin by clicking the "Equip" button
[*] [u]Please note that after the purchase, the transaction may be processed for some time (up to 5 minutes)[/u]
[*] Added 2 paid skins: [b]Baloons[/b] (Body slot) and [b]Jelly Baloons[/b] (Ability slot)
[/list]

[b]Persistent chat[/b]
[list]
[*] Chat is available in the main menu/lobby
[*] You can chat with your team in the lobby or with all players when playing the game
[*] Service notifications are also displayed in the chat
[*] Chat is persistent and doesn't reset messages when changing levels
[/list]

[b]Player agreement[/b]
[list]
[*] Added agreement text that players can accept or decline once
[*] It can be opened from the settings
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes and performance updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs and updated performance
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.6 (Early beta) Update
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability spawn now has 1 sec. cooldown
[/list]

[b]Technical improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved ability procs on clients, especially on high pings. Before that, sometimes it was tedious to press the ability button several times due to the server and client being out of sync. In this regard, the changes described in the previous paragraph were added
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.1 (Early beta) Update. Ingame chat
notes.content:
[b]Ingame chat[/b]
[list]
[*] Press "Enter" during the game to open the chat and write your messages
[*] Chat disappears after a while if no messages arrive. As soon as a new message arrives it is shown
[*] You can mute/unmute chat by pressing the "eye" button in the chat
[*] When creating a server, you can disable chat for all players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42397317/835bfe174a304319be6be775cd4af71f97f36386.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Lobby improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] All lobby members can click on a teammate's nickname to open a special menu. In this menu, you can open the player's steam profile or kick him if you are a host

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42397317/4d4866691b194167f8f518dfd8edad693c28ecb6.png[/img]
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when the snake lost, its ability has been around for a long time
[*] UI and performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0 (Early beta) Update
notes.content:
[b]Lobby[/b]
[list]
[*] You can invite your friends to your lobby through the menu button "invite" or steam overlay
[*] For now lobby supports 3 players maximum
[*] You can restart the lobby if you are the host. Also, players can leave the lobby
[*] The lobby host can create servers and players in the lobby will be instantly connected with him to the game
[*] The lobby host can choose servers and players in the lobby will be instantly connected with him to the game [i](experimental)[/i]
[*] [u]Note:[/u] Lobby will reset after the game. [i](Will be fixed in the next updates. Please don`t report this bug)[/i]
[/list]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Bug reports. There is a new menu for bug reporting in the settings. This is anonymous by default, but if you wish, you can specify an email to receive a response or attach a link to a steam profile
[*] Rotate your character with the mouse in the menu
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes and performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when at the end of the match the game was restarted instead of exiting to the lobby
[*] Improved game performance, mainly at startup
[*] Other small fixes and improvements
[/list]
